desc: BLOCKED until 206/210 gives a non-asserting NVMe path. Then complete the storage milestone on internal storage: (1) mount /dev/nvme0n1p3 exFAT, write a file, fsync, reboot, verify; (2) raw dd soak to /dev/nvme0n1p3 ONLY with md5 verify. CJ authorized 2026-08-02: writes via the mounted filesystem AND raw writes to p3 only -- NEVER raw writes to /dev/nvme0n1 or any APFS partition. Compare throughput against the SD card (58.2 GiB SDXC, already working) so we know what NVMe actually buys.
author: claude

hashes.bootargs: maxcpus=1 idle=nop nokaslr pd_ignore_unused clk_ignore_unused console=tty0 fbcon=font:TER16x32 ignore_loglevel printk.devkmsg=on console=ttydc0 console=tty0 nvmewrite=write|verify nvmewritedir=TAG [nvmewc=through] rdinit=/init (exact boot-dcuart CMDLINE; preflight OK all four)
hashes.run: PAYLOAD=nvme-exfat-write-20261025b/payload WRITE_ARGS='nvmewritedir=TAG [nvmewc=through]' scripts/t6040-run-nvme-write.sh write|verify <run-dir>; same TAG on verify
hashes.stage: stage 1 exFAT filesystem write test (5003 payload), write + verify

safety_correction_2026_10_24: 2026-10-24 SAFETY CORRECTION (claude): CJ wiped the old exFAT partition. On the current disk nvme0n1 has only p1-p3, and p3 is presumably the Apple RecoveryOS container, NOT exFAT. Never target a partition by number: any write must first match exFAT label "linux" AND GPT type EBD0A0A2-B9E5-4433-87C0-68B6B72699C7 AND the start/size pinned by read-only probe 5001, aborting on mismatch. Raw dd is not part of the plan until CJ re-authorizes it against the new partition.
plan_2026_10_25: Superseding plan (CJ rebuilt a 64 GB exFAT "linux" partition on 2026-10-25; old p3 numbering void). Stage 0 = probe 5001 (read-only) pins label, GPT type EBD0A0A2-B9E5-4433-87C0-68B6B72699C7, start/size. Stage 1 = filesystem write test (ticket 5003 builds it): gate on exactly those pins + 6001 topology/identity gates; mount the partition rw; write a deterministic pattern file (e.g. 1 GiB), fsync, sha256, umount, fsck.exfat -n, remount ro, re-verify; then a fresh-boot re-verify. Stage 2 = raw dd soak ONLY if CJ re-authorizes against the new partition. Prereq satisfied: Linux NVMe reads pass (6001 run 3).
